rules.title: Housing Stability Notification Act
rules.requirement: A landlord planning to end a tenancy or not renew a lease must give the tenant a Notice of Tenants' Rights and Resources at the same time as the Notice to Quit. The landlord must also send a copy of the notice to the City (Office of Housing Stability, via the online portal). Violations do not halt the eviction.
rules.key_value: Notice of Tenants' Rights and Resources delivered with every notice to quit/non-renewal; copy to City
rules.quoted_span: The Notice of Tenants’ Rights and Resources must be delivered at the same time as the Notice to Quit
rules.effective_date_note: Tenant FAQ states HSNA becomes effective November 6, 2020; ordinance passed October 2020.
rules.penalty: 1st offense: warning; 2nd and subsequent: $300 per day (enforced by ISD).
rules.exemptions: Residences in a hospital, skilled nursing facility or health facility; non-profit short-term substance abuse treatment facilities.

unverifiable_exemptions: residence in hospital, skilled nursing or health facility
non-profit short-term substance abuse treatment facility

rules.review_note: Notice-only requirement; it does not limit grounds for eviction. D013 gives no effective date.

rules.title: Boston Fair Chance Tenant Selection Policy (DND)
rules.requirement: Housing providers with DND funding or land, or BPDA Inclusionary Development Policy income-restricted units, may not use a blanket ban on applicants with arrests or convictions and must review case by case. They may not consider non-conviction arrests, convictions with judicial relief, juvenile records, or convictions over 5 years old (with exceptions), and may not use credit scores to approve or deny.
rules.key_value: No blanket criminal-history bans; no credit scores
rules.citation: Boston Fair Chance Tenant Selection Policy (DND, Feb. 2017)
citation_aliases: Boston Department of Neighborhood Development Fair Chance Tenant Selection Policy
rules.quoted_span: will not impose a blanket policy that denies housing to anyone with arrests and or convictions. Housing providers will consider applicants on a case-by-case basis
rules.effective_date_note: Only the February 2017 policy date is given.

requires_unknown_facts: property receives DND funding or land, or has income-restricted units under the BPDA Inclusionary Development Policy

rules.review_note: Funding-conditioned policy under which providers 'agree' to terms; federal or state conflicting criminal-history requirements preempt it.

no_rule_findings.finding: State law bars municipalities from enacting or enforcing rent control, and Boston's home-rule petition H.3744 for rent stabilization was sent to a study order, so Boston has no local rent cap.
no_rule_findings.quoted_span: No city or town may enact, maintain or enforce rent control of any kind

no_rule_findings.finding: Home-rule petition H.3744 sought tenant eviction protections for Boston but was sent to a study order (H5035) and not enacted; no local just-cause rule results (only the HSNA notice requirement exists).
no_rule_findings.quoted_span: An Act petition for a special law authorizing the city of Boston to implement rent stabilization and tenant eviction protections

dropped_candidates.reason: Merged into rent_increase_limits no_rule finding (using D048 as primary); H.3744 is also failed but supports the same no-rule cell.
Represented as no_rule finding for just_cause_eviction in the output.
Represented as no_rule finding for rent_increase_limits in the output.

parsed.notes: Boston: HSNA merged (c15, c16). Fair Chance policy kept. H.3744 failed home-rule petition: only a no-rule finding, since its operative text is not in the documents. Source-of-income discrimination appears on D012 (Boston Fair Housing Regulations) but no ordinance citation is given, so no rule was created. No documents support Boston rules for security deposits, application fees or algorithmic rent setting.
